O.outcome_detail: performance in the operating room

result.effect: 37/45 studies (82%) reported better operating-room performance associated with simulation performance

cells.quote: In total, 45 studies primarily focused on the transferability of simulation skills to the operating room. In 42 (93%) of the studies, the initial training and assessment consisted of virtual training on the dVSS with dVSS metrics as assessment, and dry lab sessions with GEARS assessment. Performance in the operating room was assessed either in real-time or with videos using the GEARS form. The control group received no simulation training. In 37 (82%) of the studies, simulation performance was correlated with better performance in the operating room.
cells.note: The systematic review reports a pooled narrative result across heterogeneous studies; the text does not specify participant ages or training duration.
